name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A memory and habit-forming layer for AI coding agents so they remember what they've learned about a project and stop repeating the same mistakes every session.
buyer: A startup CTO running a team of engineers who all use different AI coding agents and is tired of each one 're-learning' the codebase from scratch every session.
business_use_cases: An engineering team standardizes on it so every developer's coding agent shares the same learned project conventions and security rules.
A dev-tools consultancy installs and tunes it as a paid 'AI agent memory setup' service for client engineering teams.
A solo founder building with AI agents daily uses it to avoid re-explaining project architecture in every new session.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup, tuning, and 'instinct curation' services for engineering teams adopting it across their codebase.
Build a hosted team-sync layer on top so a whole org shares one evolving memory, sold as a per-seat subscription.

steal_this: This weekend, set it up on one real client codebase, measure how much repeated context it saves over a week, and use that as a case study to sell the setup service.
